conversation.text: We just bought a house and the previous owner had a system installed by you. Does the warranty transfer?
Partly.

Under the Warranty Policy, manufacturer parts warranties may transfer once to a subsequent homeowner, usually within 90 days of the home sale and subject to a manufacturer transfer fee of $50 to $100.
Meridian can provide the transfer form.
Meridian's own labor warranties do not transfer to a new homeowner, which the Warranty Policy states applies to both the installation and repair labor warranties.
If the previous owner was a Comfort Club member, the Comfort Club overview says memberships are tied to the service address and transfer to a new homeowner at the same address.
It does not say whether the 5-year installation labor warranty that members receive carries over, and the Warranty Policy says Meridian labor warranties do not transfer.
The house is at 2987 Maple St, Hutto.
Yes, Hutto is in our service area.
The Service Area document lists Pflugerville / Hutto under ZIP codes 78660 and 78634, so I can't confirm your street's ZIP from the address alone, but if it falls in one of those two, it's covered.
The Customer FAQ also lists Hutto among the areas we serve.
The transfer answer stays the same: under the Comfort Club overview, memberships are tied to the service address and transfer to a new homeowner at the same address.
No, that's it. Thanks.
Thanks for contacting Meridian Home Comfort. Have a great day.
